units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 80:14">Targ. Ps. LXXX, 14</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>ח׳ של קנים</he>, v. <cite ref="H01702"><he>חֲרִישָׁה</he> III</cite>.

Ib. to III, 4 (ref. to Ps. LXXX, 14 יער with suspended ע) אם זכיתם … מן ח׳ if you will do good, your invaders shall be (like animals) from the water (יְאֹר), if not, they shall be (like animals) from the forest; Yalk. Ps. 830.—2*) (P. Sm. 1386 angina) narrow place in the throat, windpipe.

Shebu. 6ᵇ בחוּרְשֵׁיה קא אכיל ליה that man eats into his windpipe (asks a dangerous question; Rashi: eats in his forest, i.e. knows not what is going on in the world; R. Hai G. in Ar.: he scratches his eye-sore).—Pl. חוּרְשַׁיָּא, חוּרְשֵׁי.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 4:29">Targ. Jer. IV, 29</cite>.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 24">Gen. R. s. 24</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 29:17">Is. XXIX, 17</cite>, cmp. Targ. a. l.) <he>ח׳ דבני אינש</he> thickets of people (crowded population).
